design.description: A warm, friendly woman in her late twenties with a soft, clear voice and a natural American accent. She sounds calm, kind and emotionally aware, speaks at a relaxed conversational pace, with a gentle smile in her voice.

ref_text: The old lighthouse keeper climbed the stairs every evening at six. He checked the lamp, wiped the salt from the glass, and wrote a short note in his journal. Some nights the sea was calm and quiet; other nights, waves crashed against the rocks until morning. He never once missed his watch.
